summary: Frontend-only testing of login bug fix and Pin Favourite Cities feature on admin Price Manager at https://lazy-pagination.preview.emergentagent.com. All critical flows PASS: all 4 one-click demo logins (admin/partner/customer/merchant) route to their respective panels with no 'Demo login failed' or 'Connection issue' toasts; backend /api/auth/demo-status, send-otp, verify-otp all return 200 with dev OTP 123456. Pin feature works end-to-end: pin icon reveals on hover (data-testid pm-city-pin-{key}), clicking pin moves city to FRONT of pm-city-scroller without changing the selected city, pins stack in order (first-pinned first), localStorage key pm_pinned_cities is set/updated, pins persist after reload, unpin returns city to its default order, chip click still selects (window.confirm 'unsaved pricing changes' auto-accepted and selection switched correctly), right scroll arrow (pm-city-scroll-right) scrolls horizontally (0 -> 170px). Mobile 390px renders Price Manager and scroller correctly.

design_issues.screen: Admin → Price Manager → Service Areas chip row (mobile 390px)
issues: Pin icon uses 'opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100' and shows opacity=0 on touch devices (no hover state). An unpinned city's pin icon is effectively invisible on mobile. Consider showing it at low opacity (e.g. opacity-60) on touch devices or always-visible on <md breakpoint. CityNav.jsx lines ~19-24.

action_items: Optional UX: make pin icon visible on touch/mobile breakpoints in web_panel/src/pages/admin/pricing/CityNav.jsx (currently opacity-0 w/o hover).
critical_code_review_comments: CityNav.jsx: pin icon relies on group-hover which does not fire on touch devices; the pin becomes unreachable on mobile for currently-unpinned cities. Suggest a sm:opacity-0 sm:group-hover:opacity-100 pattern so mobile shows it statically.

Login.jsx quickLogin flow silently swallows errors but current backend returns 200 — no issue in this preview URL. Earlier 'Demo login failed' toast was caused by stale REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in web_panel/.env; now fixed. Recommend asserting on config load somewhere (healthcheck) to surface misconfig earlier.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing 10 demo service areas incl. 8 with demo_scroll:true)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Price Manager is mounted inside AdminDashboard controlled by ?tab=price_manager query param (useTabParam hook). Direct navigation: /admin?tab=price_manager after login. 10 cities seeded; pin uses localStorage key pm_pinned_cities. Clicking city chip while unsaved pricing changes exist triggers window.confirm — accept it in Playwright via page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()).
rca of the issue: Login bug was due to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in web_panel/.env pointing to an old preview host; after main agent updated it to https://lazy-pagination.preview.emergentagent.com and restarted frontend, all auth endpoints respond 200 and demo logins succeed. No code bug in Login.jsx or quickLogin.
